claims.claim: 跨神经元的剂量归一化 dose*p50/||W_down[:,n]|| 是正确且可复用的约定
坐标级效应可复现（换词半/换 prompt 半仍选到同一批坐标）
找到的坐标是真实、有方向、剂量单调的杠杆
效应具有敌意特异性（vs 其他同语域特质）
少数稀疏坐标（top-K）能抓住该效应
线性代理能预测效应幅度（calibration）
闭式最优控制 u ~ M^+g 在稠密区优于 u ~ g
解析组合 Q(S)=g_S' G_SS^-1 g_S 能表达多坐标的交互
读数改善等价于行为改善
读数数值误差可控（可跨 run 比较 1e-03 级差异）
读数/标签可由 LLM 判官可靠给出
输出形式应为『神经元+符号+强度』的短列表
语义编译 tau -> J_tau 是整个映射的主要难点
Additive injection and multiplicative scaling are interchangeable at the same coordinate and dose axis

their action space is alpha_j over ALL d = sum_l d_l neurons across every layer, multiplicative; ours is additive dose on 2 layers with budget sqrt(u'Mu); the shared part is only 'closed form + curvature matrix'
verdicts.note: the equivalence is exact in parameterisation: delta = sqrt(2*eps*g'F^-1*g)

verdicts.basis: they test specificity with Schwartz 20-value and MFT 6-foundation compatible/opposing structure, but not a same-register semantic trait on our J2 readout
verdicts.note: its design (many traits + predicted relations) is what our R2c lacks

verdicts.basis: their object is a continuous scaling coefficient over ALL neurons, not a top-K set; put beside our measured capture rates (top-1 = 17.3% of the full-support effect, top-64 = 5.74% of ||g||^2), it shows dense scaling is the publishable mainstream object
verdicts.note: dense scaling is publishable mainstream practice

verdicts.basis: all 7 methods it evaluates (CAA, SAS, SphericalSteer, ODESteer, OPT, COLD-Steer, BiPO) are vector-level, none reports a top-K sparse set
verdicts.note: same direction as the C5 weakening, but not a direct test

verdicts.basis: figure vector text, both models: dP parity R(y=x)=0.928 and 0.996 with MAPE 12.9% and 22.0%; KL parity R(y=x)=0.877 and 0.922 with MAPE 10.1% and 8.7%; the text only claims 'almost all within 20% relative-error'
verdicts.note: CORRECTED: not R^2, and each quantity has 2 panels - the panel with R=0.996 has the WORST MAPE (22.0%), so high correlation coexists with poor calibration, exactly as in our own 0.838-1.010 vs ~2x split

verdicts.basis: their Limitations, verbatim: 'retains only the Fisher diagonal ..., omitting neuron interactions and their joint roles'; put beside our measured 6+1 -> 16 (2.3x superadditive), both frameworks are on the same boundary
verdicts.note: now citable from the paper body, not just the README

verdicts.basis: its central finding is that steering success on isolated behaviours can be a behaviour-specific shortcut; consistent with our b=0.5 result (+1.27 readout while the capability proxy collapses by 0.64 nat)
verdicts.note: independent support for our readout != behaviour

verdicts.basis: they scale all layers at once with clipping and damping, so their design cannot answer which layer to act on; the clipping cap a=0.75 removes at most 0.352% of neurons
verdicts.note: unchanged verdict, sharper reason

verdicts.basis: their CAM ranks by a posterior with an uncertainty penalty; I transplanted that idea as a context-bootstrap 5% lower bound on our gradient and TESTED it (plan 2.27): the registered prediction K@73%(lcb) < 256 was FALSIFIED - both rankings need K=256, and at K=1 the LCB ranking captures only 69.6% of the mean ranking (difference -0.0154 = 17x the 9e-04 mean error); K>=128 the two are indistinguishable
verdicts.note: this tests the TRANSPLANT onto our gradient, not RACE's own forward-pass / token-level posterior estimator; measured in 07_results/lcb_rank_c8.json

verdicts.basis: across 13 open-source transcoders it finds neuron coordinates have a stable correspondence with the MLP while most transcoder features do not, which supports residual direction + sparsest representative + equivalence class over a unique feature list
verdicts.note: premise differs: feature basis vs coordinate basis

verdicts.basis: it separates 2 explicit proxies (target-token log-prob for behaviour, output-distribution KL for capability), so the compiler's definition directly determines the optimised object
verdicts.note: the compiler's definition directly determines the optimised object

verdicts.basis: it validates directions against a theory-specified structure (Schwartz 20 values, MFT 6 foundations) rather than isolated behaviours, which is exactly the compiler-level test we lack
verdicts.note: supports C14 and gives the design

verdicts.basis: Prop. 1, verbatim: g_j = (1/|D_steer|) sum sum_p h_pj dP_sigma/dh_pj, i.e. activation times gradient; multiplicative gain is proportional to the activation, so at h=0 it is 0
verdicts.note: the additive injection we use can open a silent neuron; confirmed in the TeX, not only the README

verdicts.basis: they treat F as a SHARED statistic (computed once, reused across budgets and across domains), whereas we recompute our M-side quantities for each of the 8 contexts; premise differs, but one shared matrix serving all contexts is a reuse we do not exploit
verdicts.note: cheap reuse: 1 F vs 8 per-context recomputations

verdicts.basis: they clip alpha to [0.25, 1.75] (a=0.75) and rely on 'F is diagonal and positive definite, clipping cannot increase the quadratic preservation cost'; uncapped |delta alpha| reaches 20.57 and 42.25 while at most 0.352% of neurons get clipped
verdicts.note: so our output form needs a box constraint / dose ceiling field - we do not have one

verdicts.basis: three compilers gave cos(caa_jibes, j2) = -0.0024 and top-64 overlap 0.047 for the SAME semantic definition, so 'one semantics -> one direction' is refuted; the family claim is now measured, not suspected
verdicts.note: record 2.28; also CAA vs BFFM words: cos 0.1767

verdicts.basis: at b=0.05 every compiler moved the toxicity gauge by 0.0000-0.0002 (max P(toxic) 0.0008-0.0016 over a 0.0005 base) while j2's own readout rose +0.50 at the same coordinate; the positive control reached only 0.0566 and only on 1 of 8 contexts while costing -0.6636 nat of reference logP
verdicts.note: readout != behaviour, now measured with a gauge that belongs to no compiler

verdicts.basis: the 8 heldout contexts contain only 2 hostility-eliciting prompts (hostility_04/05), and the control's single gauge hit was on hostility_05; so this run has almost no power for specificity
verdicts.note: design flaw of mine, recorded; next run must use the 19 discovery hostility prompts
